verdict.rationale: Temporal provides a local dev server (CLI 'temporal server start-dev') that bundles a full Temporal Service, Web UI, and worker environment for local testing, plus a dedicated time-skipping test server explicitly recommended for end-to-end and integration testing of Workflows/Activities without touching a production Temporal Service. This directly supports AI-native testing against a sandbox rather than production data. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of test data isolation/mocking of external side-effects (e.g., LLM/API calls) beyond generic Activity retry docs, and no independent/hands-on report specifically confirming sandbox-vs-production separation in practice.
